description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing lookup tables associated with surveys. It includes endpoints to list, retrieve, and create lookup table entries, leveraging JAX-RS annotations, Swagger/OpenAPI annotations, and Spring components.

classes.name: LookupTableApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing lookup tables related to surveys in the Fineract system.

methods.name: fetchLookupTables
methods.description: Endpoint to list all lookup table entries for a specific survey.

methods.name: findLookupTable
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific lookup table entry by key within a survey.

methods.name: createLookupTable
methods.description: Endpoint to add a new lookup table entry to a survey.

methods.name: findSurvey
methods.description: Private helper method to fetch a survey by ID or throw an exception if not found.
